summary: The FBI is still investigating a break-in at its national crime database. No one has said who did it. Stocks swung hard Wednesday and mostly recovered, and Bitcoin sits near 59,000 dollars. No official source links these events.

events.title: FBI investigating break-in at its national crime database
events.impact: Police use this database for warrant checks and stolen car records. Nobody has said what was taken, whether records were changed, or whether police lost access.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Patel confirmed an active investigation on Nov 24 but gave no details. No group has claimed it. No official link to the September FBI jobs portal breach.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation systems were shut down. As of Nov 24, USDA had not said if all systems are back or if financial data was taken.
events.stated_cause: A USDA official said systems were shut down over a cyber threat and no personal data was lost. No attacker has been named.

events.title: Wild swing in US stocks: Nasdaq fell 4.6% early, then recovered
events.impact: Close Nov 25: S&P 500 7,182.78 (-0.25%), Dow 50,182.95 (+0.33%), Nasdaq 23,585.80 (-0.62%). Nasdaq-100 briefly hit 20% below its peak. US markets are closed today for Thanksgiving.
events.stated_cause: Reports point to hot inflation data, AI profit worries and new tariff plans. No technical fault or cyber attack is reported. I found no trading halts.

events.title: Bitcoin near 58-60K USD, down about 6-8% on the week
events.impact: Coinbase 58,651 (-6% on the week); Coinglass 58,244 (24h range 57,876 to 60,675); CoinGecko 60,847 (+2.8% on the day). Sources differ a little. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Commentary points to hot inflation data and selling of risky assets.

events.title: More tanker incidents near Strait of Hormuz
events.impact: Iran says more tankers, including an LNG ship, hit mines Wednesday. One daily brief puts Brent near 95 dollars, up about 3.6%. IMO says the strait is unsafe.
events.stated_cause: Iran says mines. UK maritime agency has reported unidentified projectiles on earlier hits. Iranian claims are not independently verified. WSJ reports US is probing Iran over tanker cyberattacks.

events.title: CISA adds 10 more actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Nov 25 additions cover Danfoss, HPE Juniper, Mitel and Vates products. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not tie the flaws to the FBI or USDA incidents.

events.title: Report of ongoing Allstate customer service outage
events.impact: One site says customers have limited access to services nationwide. Start time and scope are unknown. I found no second source or company statement.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Nobody has given a cause.

events.title: Reported separate breach of CIA and intelligence office network
events.impact: Said to involve an unclassified open-source analysis network. Full scope is unknown. No new reporting found this run.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Unnamed sources only. No agency statement and no second independent source.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows reduced performance on Sites and Services
events.impact: Status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 00:11 UTC today. I found no news report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The FBI and USDA incidents are cyber events with no named attacker. Stocks fell on inflation, AI worries and tariffs. Tanker hits are blamed on mines by Iran. No official source links any of them.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same attacker or company, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: No new confirmed outage or official link between events since the last run.

prep_note: Nothing special is needed. If you are a farmer waiting on USDA loans or payments, check with your local office. Keep a little cash and your usual backups. Markets are closed today and close early Friday.
